# XferAI-Bench

> Local, offline benchmark for cold-start retail forecasting: an existing item launching at a Forecast Pixel Group (FPG) where it has never sold, 52 weekly forecasts, PAIR0-E and PAIR0-N scored separately. Built-in data is synthetic; public rankings are pending.

- [DIY Getting Started (run on your own data with a coding assistant)](docs/DIY-GettingStarted.md)

- [AI engineer knowledge base](AIENGINEER.md)
- [VISUELLE/GTM reproduction (research only, results pending)](experiments/exp03_visuelle_gtm/README.md)
